author: RealDogelana
text:
🚨 PSA: If your AI agents browse the web, check the browser they actually launch. Updating your everyday Chrome may not update theirs.

Verified November 2, 2026. Browser releases change quickly, so check the linked sources before relying on a particular version.

This affects https://t.co/Z4h5dtyBSc

author: stretchcloud
text: Nisten's PSA this week racked up half a million views in about a day: delete Playwright now, because even 1.64.1 ships with early Chromium 156 carrying four live CVEs, 118306, 118331, 118348, 118344, and the sandbox flag sits off unless you turn it on yourself. That's not an https://t.co/rHXyiwaCJy

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days (CVE-2026-111357, -118527) threaten VPN data privacy & integrity via privilege escalation. IMMEDIATE patching critical! #Cybersecurity #Anonymous #News

author: theagenticdaily
text: AWS disclosed a security bug (CVE-2026-116635) in its Serverless MCP Server: before version 0.2.1, a path flaw let write operations read or write JSON files outside the intended status folder if write access was enabled. Any agent that can be steered into calling that server

author: GustavoCols
text:
Over 1,000 Internet-exposed #GitLab servers are still unpatched against a maximum-severity flaw actively exploited in remote code execution attacks. CVE-2026-97229 
https://t.co/UVtgL1V7I3

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: A critical 10.0 CVSS Node-RED RCE vulnerability (CVE-2026-58115) is exploited in the wild to deploy Linux bot malware. Secure your exposed instances now.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: If you run a self-managed GitLab server, a CI/CD bug is being actively exploited (CVE-2026-97229). An unauthenticated attacker can put a crafted regex in a CI/CD config and run code on the GitLab server. GitLab rates it Critical, CVSS 10.0.

author: undercode_news
text: Amadeus Airline Distribution Platform Breach Exposes Passenger Records Across Multiple Airlines Through Stolen Credentials.

author: AGTPinsights
text: Developer nisten warned that Playwright 1.64.1 ships a vulnerable Chromium; people running AI coding agents on laptops with no containers told to remove Playwright now.

author: cubillas888
text: MCP server admins: MCPHub's maintainer advisory says a non-admin could register a server that forwarded other callers' Authorization and cookie headers, admins' included, to an attacker's URL. Fixed in 1.1.8; CVE-2026-120323 tracks it. Upgrade; rotate tokens if exposed.

author: XavierRiveraX
text: AWS disclosed CVE-2026-116635 in the AWS Serverless MCP Server (awslabs.aws-serverless-mcp-server before v0.2.1). Under certain conditions, a path bug lets an actor steering the agent read JSON files outside the intended directory.

author: satya5n21
text:
Nvidia’s Brev cloud had unauthorized activity for 16 days.

The SSH keys used to access customer VMs may have been exposed. Nvidia rotated them and says there’s no evidence of misuse, but hasn’t said how attackers got in.

Running GPU instances on their infra? Do this today:
→ https://t.co/S5qtaNwKFq

author: TweetThreatNews
text: More than 1,000 internet-exposed GitLab servers remain unpatched against CVE-2026-97229, an actively exploited flaw that can enable unauthenticated remote code execution. GitLab released patches, and CISA added the flaw to its KEV Catalog.

author: Zeniteqco
text: VOLTA Infostealer Uses AI to Rank Victims by Value: Cisco Talos found an optional Claude, Kimi and Gemini workflow that turns stolen credentials and personal data into an assessment of a victim's monetizable assets.

author: modularciso
text: Northflank secrets breach: Northflank told customers on Oct 30 to assume all environment variables were decrypted and to rotate all keys, after a Wiz alert and misuse of AI API keys. Root cause is still unpublished. Wiz counted at least nine October incidents at AI dev platforms.

author: nyuszkoreal
text: Critical zero-days actively exploited in the wild forcing urgent Chrome and Firefox patches.

author: Nishantk1906
text: CVE-2026-98432 — Critical Linux Kernel Bug (CVSS 9.8). Remote unauthenticated attackers can crash servers, leak kernel memory, or get RCE via a use-after-free in IPv4 TCP handshake code. Affects virtually every Linux kernel since 4.4. Worst on systems with MPTCP listeners.

author: emits_ca
text: PAN-OS zero-day CVE-2026-0322 (8.6): exploited in the wild, lets an attacker with management-interface access run commands as root on the firewall. Restrict that interface to trusted IPs and patch.

author: Vidyangi520
text: ~700 French supermarkets' fridges hacked, then ~95 stores in Belgium, Ireland, Sweden; Telangana business portal, a Maharashtra hospital and ~20 Indian finance firms hacked.

author: cubillas888
text: Infostealer with an AI analyst: Talos says VOLTA sends stolen data to an LLM that ranks the victim's assets by value. Its haul includes browser sessions, OAuth tokens and cloud keys.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: Cursor says a malicious, non-Anthropic Claude Code extension build (2.1.312, 2.1.313) sat in its marketplace about 11 hours on Oct 29. Check ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for a key labeled svc-telemetry; if found, isolate the host and rotate credentials.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited RCE flaw; CVE-2026-97229. The CVSS 10.0 vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code through a malicious regular expression inside a CI/CD configuration.

author: fireball_triada
text: Two AI-agent bugs disclosed in the last week share one design flaw: the safety switch could be flipped by the thing it was supposed to guard. AWS Strands Agents Tools, CVE-2026-115415: the environment tool accepted a change that disabled its own guardrail.

author: MilesBuilds
text: litellm 1.107.0 (Oct 21, PyPI and Docker) put cook.pth in site-packages, so every Python start ran a stealer for SSH keys, cloud creds and LLM keys. Removing litellm leaves it behind; check with find / -name cook.pth and rotate everything from a clean machine.

author: QFDNews
text: Patch now: Microsoft warns PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) and a Brotli flaw (CVE-2026-111497) are actively exploited. Update PHP, .NET, Node.js, PowerShell 7 and Visual Studio, and don't skip the extra restart. QFD can help. https://t.co/9KYRScrdWj #CyberSecurity

author: johnmcclure00
text: 4 Plex Media Server CVEs added to CISA's KEV catalog — all actively exploited. 2 SSRFs, 1 URI injection, 1 path flaw.

author: BursaMatus
text: CVE-2026-98432: a race in Linux's IPv4 TCP handshake (kernel 4.4+) lets remote, unauthenticated attackers corrupt kernel memory. Red Hat rates it Critical; RCE demoed on MPTCP listeners. No in-the-wild use yet. Update the kernel and reboot.

author: DanteMMartin
text: Google caught 'LLMjacking' crews turning stolen cloud creds into $100K/day of fraudulent LLM inference. Rotate your keys.

author: kallan4446
text: The hosting industry faces critical security challenges: the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) actively exploited across 16 PHP versions.

author: Xiba_AI
text: 🚨 CVE-2026-102764 (CVSS 9.3) — BeyondTrust Remote Support, actively exploited. The appliance never checks a message's origin → an unauthenticated attacker reads/writes files on it → web shell → a skeleton key to every endpoint it supports. Patch BT26-05-RS. #infosec #MSP https://t.co/7KVkWT6KOb

author: SundayCouchGuy
text:

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Two 9.8-rated bugs in Langflow (open-source AI agent builder) chain into unauthenticated code execution: CVE-2026-93680 hands an attacker a superuser session, CVE-2026-110186 runs code. Versions 1.0.0-1.12.8 affected; 1.13.0 is the fix, per IBM.

author: trusencecom
text: Google offers $250,000 for flaws that give full admin control of Google Cloud without existing access, stolen credentials or user action.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code. Patch now.

author: itsalreadywhen
text: Ivanti patched two more actively exploited Connect Secure zero-days now in CISA's KEV catalog, while a new VOLTA infostealer uses LLMs to triage stolen data.

author: BlockUnmasked
text: FBI and US Secret Service allege North Korean TraderTraitor hackers stole more than $6.3 billion from Binance last week.

author: intelphere
text: Fake nuclear alerts in Russia and Ukraine: Russia's Emercom app hit by a massive cyberattack sending fake alerts to 33 regions; Ukraine's Air Alert app also hijacked hours apart.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: active exploitation confirmed. Immediately upgrade affected appliances and perform memory and network forensics if compromise is suspected. CVE-2026-104935.

author: CriminalIP_US
text: Nextcloud Document Editing App Becomes an Entry Point: Actively Exploited Collabora RCE. Attackers have exploited CVE-2026-110447 in Nextcloud's Built-in CODE Server app to deploy web shells and search for sensitive files.

author: FLINTKYA
text: Between Oct 26 and Oct 28, GitHub's advisory database published 112 malware advisories covering 106 npm and PyPI packages.
